name: XDK XAPI (XAPILIB, and its USB stack XPP)
_why: RECOMP_DISPATCH_GATE: XPP locks only by raising to DISPATCH_LEVEL, which is a lock on the one-CPU console only.
Without the gate XInputSetState and the USB DPC run side by side and corrupt the TD pool: pad dead within a
minute (Fable, 0x0086E480-0x00876C3C), DPCs at DISPATCH reported (Burnout 3). The gate needs the paced vblank loop.
RECOMP_USB / RECOMP_KEYBOARD: the pad through the USB model; the keyboard stands in for it on a desktop.
